intro.en: A coaxial cable is a controlled transmission structure: the center conductor, dielectric and concentric outer conductor jointly establish impedance and contain the electromagnetic field. Cable name alone does not define a finished assembly.
intro.zh: 同轴电缆是一种受控传输结构：中心导体、介质与同心外导体共同建立阻抗并约束电磁场。只有线缆名称，不能完整定义成品组件。

knowledge.en: A useful specification connects system impedance, frequency band, allowable loss, power, length, connector interface, installation route and test evidence. A mechanically mating connector or familiar RG designation does not prove electrical compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 有效规格应把系统阻抗、频率范围、允许损耗、功率、长度、连接器界面、安装路径与测试证据联系起来。能够机械对插的接头或熟悉的 RG 名称，并不能证明电气兼容。

subtitle.en: Preserve impedance through every cable, connector and transition
subtitle.zh: 让阻抗控制贯穿线缆、连接器与每一处过渡

lead.en: Define the complete RF, video or instrumentation channel before selecting cable and termination.
lead.zh: 先定义完整射频、视频或仪器通道，再选择线缆与端接方式。

title.zh: 同轴几何决定电磁场分布

copy.en: The center conductor carries the signal while the surrounding dielectric sets spacing and the outer conductor provides the return path and shielding boundary. Conductor diameter, dielectric properties and concentricity influence characteristic impedance. Crushing, eccentric stripping or a poorly supported transition changes that geometry even when continuity remains intact.
copy.zh: 中心导体承载信号，周围介质确定间距，外导体形成回流路径与屏蔽边界。导体直径、介质特性和同心度都会影响特性阻抗。挤压、偏心剥线或缺少支撑的过渡会改变几何结构，即使导通仍然正常。

title.en: 50 ohm and 75 ohm are different systems
title.zh: 50 Ω 与 75 Ω 属于不同系统

copy.en: Fifty-ohm coax is widely used for RF, radio and data links where power handling and loss are balanced. Seventy-five-ohm coax is common in video, broadcast and distribution systems. Some connector families are offered in both impedances and may appear to mate, but internal geometry differs. Record the equipment impedance and exact connector version instead of choosing by shell appearance.
copy.zh: 50 Ω 同轴常用于射频、无线电与数据链路，在功率能力与损耗之间取得平衡；75 Ω 同轴则常见于视频、广播和分配系统。部分连接器家族同时提供两种阻抗版本，外观看似可以对插，但内部几何不同。应记录设备阻抗与准确接口版本，不能按外壳外观选型。

title.en: Loss belongs to frequency, length and temperature
title.zh: 损耗必须结合频率、长度与温度

copy.en: Attenuation normally increases with frequency and cable length. Conductor construction, dielectric loss, shield design and temperature also matter. For transmit paths, average and peak power, ambient conditions, altitude and connector heating may constrain the assembly. Select from the supplier data for the exact cable construction and calculate margin across the complete installed path.
copy.zh: 衰减通常随频率和长度增加，导体结构、介质损耗、屏蔽设计与温度同样重要。对于发射通道，平均与峰值功率、环境温度、海拔及连接器发热都可能形成限制。应依据准确线缆结构的供应商数据选型，并对完整安装路径计算余量。

title.en: Flexible, miniature, low-loss and semi-rigid cable
title.zh: 柔性、微型、低损耗与半刚同轴

copy.en: Flexible braided coax supports service routing; miniature constructions fit compact electronics; low-loss families use larger diameters or foamed dielectrics; semi-rigid cable preserves a stable formed route. RG names are useful references but may cover constructions from different suppliers. Confirm conductor, dielectric, shield, jacket, outside diameter, bend limits and connector termination range.
copy.zh: 编织柔性同轴适合维护布线，微型结构用于紧凑电子设备，低损耗系列常通过更大外径或发泡介质降低衰减，半刚同轴则保持稳定成形路径。RG 名称可作参考，但不同供应商的结构可能不同。需要确认导体、介质、屏蔽、护套、外径、弯曲限制以及连接器可端接范围。

title.en: Match connector family, impedance and cable group
title.zh: 同时匹配连接器家族、阻抗与线缆组

copy.en: SMA, SMB, BNC, N, MCX, MMCX, FAKRA and other interfaces differ in coupling method, frequency range, size, polarity and environmental options. Within one family, plug or jack, straight or right-angle, bulkhead or cable-end and standard or reverse polarity must be identified. The rear termination must also match the exact cable diameter and braid or jacket build.
copy.zh: SMA、SMB、BNC、N、MCX、MMCX、FAKRA 等接口在耦合方式、频率范围、尺寸、极性与环境选项上各不相同。同一家族内还要区分插头或插座、直式或弯式、面板端或线端、标准或反极性。连接器尾部端接范围也必须匹配准确的线径、编织与护套结构。

title.en: A good termination preserves the coaxial transition
title.zh: 合格端接要保持同轴过渡

copy.en: Strip dimensions determine how the center conductor, dielectric, braid and jacket enter the connector. Stray braid strands, nicked conductors, excessive solder, loose ferrules or unsupported dielectric can create shorts, impedance steps and weak strain relief. Tooling, preparation dimensions and pull or visual criteria should be tied to the connector and cable combination.
copy.zh: 剥线尺寸决定中心导体、介质、编织层与护套如何进入连接器。散乱编织丝、导体损伤、焊料过多、压套松动或介质缺少支撑，都可能造成短路、阻抗突变和应力释放不足。工装、备线尺寸以及拉力或外观准则应绑定具体连接器与线缆组合。

title.en: Continuity cannot verify a high-frequency channel
title.zh: 导通无法验证高频通道

copy.en: Continuity and insulation checks find opens, shorts and gross assembly faults, but they do not measure channel behavior. Where the project requires it, verify insertion loss, return loss or VSWR, characteristic impedance, phase or group delay over a defined frequency range. Fixtures, adapters, reference planes, calibration and acceptance limits belong in the test method.
copy.zh: 导通与绝缘检查可以发现断路、短路和明显装配缺陷，但不能测量通道特性。项目需要时，应在规定频率范围内验证插入损耗、回波损耗或 VSWR、特性阻抗、相位或群时延。夹具、转接器、参考面、校准方式与判定限值都应写入测试方法。

title.en: Release the assembly with traceable inputs
title.zh: 依据可追溯输入放行组件

copy.en: A repeatable coax assembly record includes exact cable and connector part numbers, impedance, length and tolerances, orientation, strip and termination controls, labels, environmental requirements and agreed electrical evidence. For antenna, broadcast, GNSS, test-equipment or industrial sensor paths, the equipment ports and operating band should remain linked to the released drawing and inspection plan.
copy.zh: 可重复生产的同轴组件记录应包含准确线缆与连接器料号、阻抗、长度和公差、方向、剥线与端接控制、标签、环境要求及约定电气证据。对于天线、广播、GNSS、测试设备或工业传感器通道，设备端口与工作频段应始终关联到受控图纸和检验计划。

inputs.en: Equipment ports, connector gender, interface family and polarity
inputs.zh: 设备端口、连接器公母、接口家族与极性

inputs.en: System impedance, operating frequency band and signal or power type
inputs.zh: 系统阻抗、工作频段以及信号或功率类型

inputs.en: Exact cable preference or limits for loss, diameter and flexibility
inputs.zh: 指定线缆，或损耗、外径与柔性限制

inputs.en: Finished length, tolerance, route, bend space and installation movement
inputs.zh: 成品长度、公差、路径、弯曲空间与安装运动

inputs.en: Temperature, moisture, UV, fluids, flame and regulatory requirements
inputs.zh: 温度、潮湿、紫外线、液体、阻燃与法规要求

inputs.en: Required continuity, insulation, pull, insertion-loss or return-loss evidence
inputs.zh: 所需导通、绝缘、拉力、插损或回损证据

q.en: Can a 50-ohm connector be used on a 75-ohm system?
q.zh: 50 Ω 连接器可以用于 75 Ω 系统吗？

a.en: Do not assume so because the parts mate. The impedance transition can increase reflection. Confirm the equipment, frequency, connector version and allowed channel performance.
a.zh: 不能因为可以对插就直接使用。阻抗过渡可能增加反射，应确认设备、频率、连接器版本与允许的通道性能。

q.en: Is an RG number enough to quote the assembly?
q.zh: 只有 RG 编号能否完成报价？

a.en: It is a starting point. Supplier construction, impedance, dimensions, jacket, temperature rating, shield and compatible connector group still need confirmation.
a.zh: RG 编号只是起点，还需确认供应商结构、阻抗、尺寸、护套、耐温、屏蔽及兼容连接器组。

q.en: Why test return loss if the cable passes continuity?
q.zh: 已经导通，为什么还要测试回波损耗？

a.en: Continuity shows an electrical path exists. Return loss indicates how well impedance is maintained through the cable and transitions over frequency; the project decides whether this evidence is necessary.
a.zh: 导通只说明电气路径存在；回波损耗反映线缆与过渡在频率范围内维持阻抗的程度，是否需要此项证据由项目决定。
